exposure: Cases: Neonates diagnosed with sepsis by clinical criteria and laboratory findings
Controls: Admitted neonates without suspected or diagnosed sepsis
cohort: 174 neonates diagnosed with sepsis and 348 neonates without sepsis admitted to the ICU
finding: Both maternal and neonatal variables, particularly premature rupture of membranes, gestational age, neonatal age, birth weight, and mode of delivery, were significantly associated with the risk of neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be a significant predictor of neonatal sepsis.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured and found to be significantly associated with sepsis risk.
